title: New vegas in fallout 4?
author: Crafty_Code6428
selftext: Hey I'm new to AI and have been seeing those AI game Mashup. Has anyone tried using AI to remake Fallout NV in the Fallout 4 or starfield engine? I think it would probably be easier than the Skate 3 in MW2 Mashup since they have so much in common. Sorry if this is in the wrong community like I said Im new to AI.

comments.author: Flyingcoyote
comments.body: Bethesda is currently working on a Fallout NV and 3 remaster I think.

replies.author: Crafty_Code6428
replies.body: Yes but I doubt the remasters will have 4s gunplay or weapon/armor modding which is the main thing I wanted from all this. Just going by the oblivion remake that is

comments.author: cxfoulke
comments.body:
There is 100 hours+ of  content in nv. 

It's not a simple copy and paste. It's easier to take a single mechanics vs just a shit ton of content. 

Your not setting up the ai to port your remaking new Vegas in newer version of the engine. It would take 1000s of hours and an ungodly amount of tokens. 

Or your cheating in some weird way which will reduce the point of the project.

replies.author: Crafty_Code6428
replies.body: So moving the existing NV content to the 4 engine would be too much for it? That sucks. Honestly if NV had the gunplay and weapon modding from 4 it would be perfect

replies.author: cxfoulke
replies.body: Would be easier to make a nv mod that brings gunplay and weapon modding to nv.

replies.author: Crafty_Code6428
replies.body: I dont think the gunplay is gonna be able to feel nearly as good in the older engine but the weapon modding seems possible.

replies.author: Valdaraak
replies.body: It'd have to re-write and rebuild the entire game. There's a reason the Oblivion remaster didn't port the game to the newer engine and instead just ran the original through a visual UE wrapper. They're completely different games in completely different engines with completely different things that happen behind the scenes.

comments.author: Jolly-Rip5973
comments.body:
There are honestly a number of mod list and packages available.   
  
Stick DLSS 5 on there and it's going to look pretty damn great with some mods installed.   
  
 The Creation Engine isn't open source but there is a "Creation Kit" toolset to create mods, quests, add-ons. 

I think remastering the game to an entirely different engine would be a very long project. 

I guess you could see if Claude or Astra can control the creation kit though.

comments.author: Deepwalkerq
comments.body: Check "@chasmmm" on youtube, in his discord server people share their mashups. I saw someone is porting F:NV to Rust there and also Tarkov x Fallout in his vid.
